fema.rule: Distinct major-disaster (DR) declarations naming the county since 2000-01-01, one per disaster number (FEMA lists New England towns separately under one county code); Biological (COVID-19) and emergency (EM) or fire-management (FM) declarations excluded; statewide or tribal designations count for the state only. Connecticut's planning regions count a disaster declared for any old county they overlap (Census Bureau town crosswalk). A declaration is an administrative act, not a measure of damage.
